messages.en: Could you move this box a little to the side, please? I need to get through.
Sure, I'll move it now. Next to this desk, right?
I've prepared everything. May Allah make things go smoothly for me tomorrow.
Ameen. Just get some rest tonight. You've already put in a lot of effort.
You've moved, right? Is it peaceful there at night?
Yeah, it's peaceful. The neighbours aren't noisy either, so it's easy to get to sleep.
I've already warned him not to block that emergency exit.
He's moved the box out of the way. The passage is clear now.
